lines.zh: 我从沙洞里探出上半身，随水摇。
lines.en: I lift my upper half from the burrow and sway with the water.

lines.zh: 我摆着细长的身子，像一根草。
lines.en: I wave my slender body like a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 水流过来，我顺着倒向一边。
lines.en: The current comes and I lean with it to one side.

lines.zh: 我们一片一起摇，滩上全是影子。
lines.en: We sway as one patch, shadows all over the flat.

lines.zh: 我换个洞，钻进去又探出来。
lines.en: I move to another hole, dive in, and poke back out.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面横移一小段。
lines.en: I shift sideways a short way along the sand.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴先探，再整条钻进去。
lines.en: I test with my tail first, then slide all the way in.

lines.zh: 我在海草中间慢慢漂。
lines.en: I drift slowly among the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我一缩身，就只剩个头在外面。
lines.en: One contraction and only my head stays out.

lines.zh: 暖水推着我，我歪了又正。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me over and I straighten again.

lines.zh: 同伴都朝一个方向，我也跟着。
lines.en: My neighbors all lean one way, so I follow.

lines.zh: 我从洞口探出去，够远一点。
lines.en: I stretch out of the burrow to reach a little farther.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙爬过一条浅沟。
lines.en: I slide along the sand across a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我的身体一节一节地摆过去。
lines.en: My body waves past segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我松开沙，让水把我推了半尺。
lines.en: I loosen my grip on the sand and let the water push me half a foot.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，去看旁边那个洞。
lines.en: I curve over to check the burrow next door.

lines.zh: 我整条立起来，又慢慢落回沙里。
lines.en: I stand fully upright, then settle slowly back into the sand.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地缩，像收一根线。
lines.en: I retract section by section, like winding in a line.

lines.zh: 我定在洞口，任水流梳我的身。
lines.en: I hold at the burrow mouth and let the current comb me.

lines.zh: 我只露出半截，剩下全在沙里。
lines.en: Only half of me shows; the rest is in the sand.

lines.zh: 一只小虾游过，我懒得动。
lines.en: A tiny shrimp swims by and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我们整片都不动，像一片草。
lines.en: Our whole patch stays still, like a bed of grass.

lines.zh: 气泡从我嘴边升到水面。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my mouth to the surface.

lines.zh: 我把头转向光的那一边。
lines.en: I turn my head toward the light.

lines.zh: 沙很软，我把自己埋得更深。
lines.en: The sand is soft, so I bury myself deeper.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，什么也没发生。
lines.en: I stare at the surface and nothing happens.

lines.zh: 同伴缩了，我还没缩。
lines.en: My neighbor retracts; I have not yet.

lines.zh: 潮水稳定，我慢慢呼气。
lines.en: The tide is steady and I breathe out slowly.

lines.zh: 我把身子绕了个小弯。
lines.en: I curve my body into a small bend.

lines.zh: 海草拂过我，我不理它。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes me and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 洞里凉，我待着很舒服。
lines.en: The burrow is cool and comfortable.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的摆动，犯困了。
lines.en: I count my own swaying and grow sleepy.

lines.zh: 我从洞口支起身看你。
lines.en: I prop myself up from the burrow to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我矮了一截。
lines.en: Your shadow presses over and I shrink down a notch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，一只眼对你。
lines.en: I tilt my head so one eye faces you.

lines.zh: 你在滩上站着，我露出更多。
lines.en: You stand on the flat and I show more of myself.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就往洞里缩。
lines.en: You move and I retract into the burrow.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你蹲下的样子。
lines.en: Through the water I watch you crouch down.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉直，尽量高一点。
lines.en: I straighten up as tall as I can manage.

lines.zh: 你走近，整片我们都缩了。
lines.en: You come closer and our whole patch retracts.

lines.zh: 沙里只露出一截，别踩我。
lines.en: Only a stub shows above the sand; don't step.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才重新探出来。
lines.en: You step back and only then do I emerge again.

lines.zh: 身上被咬掉一段，我缩进沙里。
lines.en: A piece is bitten off me and I pull into the sand.

lines.zh: 疼得我整条都在抖。
lines.en: The pain makes my whole body tremble.

lines.zh: 我拼命往洞里钻，只留尾尖。
lines.en: I force myself down the burrow with only my tail tip out.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从洞里扯出来半个身。
lines.en: That yank pulls half my body out of the burrow.

lines.zh: 我伤在中间，摆不起来。
lines.en: I am hurt in the middle and cannot sway.

lines.zh: 沙里的血慢慢散开了。
lines.en: Blood in the sand slowly spreads.

lines.zh: 我挤在洞里，动一下就疼。
lines.en: Wedged in the burrow, every movement hurts.

lines.zh: 牙齿印留在身上，火辣辣的。
lines.en: Tooth marks remain on me, stinging.

lines.zh: 我硬撑着不倒，身子在颤。
lines.en: I hold myself upright, trembling.

lines.zh: 疼也没用，我只能等它走。
lines.en: Pain helps nothing; I can only wait for it to leave.

lines.zh: 有小东西沉下来，我探身去够。
lines.en: Something small sinks and I lean out to reach it.

lines.zh: 你在洞口撒了食，我犹豫。
lines.en: You scatter food at my burrow and I hesitate.

lines.zh: 味道近，我把身子拉得很长。
lines.en: The smell is close and I stretch my body out long.

lines.zh: 同伴都伸长了，我也跟着。
lines.en: My neighbors stretch out and I do the same.

lines.zh: 我离洞口太远，心里发慌。
lines.en: I am too far from the burrow and I feel panic rising.

lines.zh: 那团碎屑在漂，我追了半尺。
lines.en: A morsel drifts by and I chase it half a foot.

lines.zh: 我又想吃，又怕被抓。
lines.en: I want to eat, but I fear being caught.

lines.zh: 食物落到沙上，我缩了一下。
lines.en: The food lands on the sand and I flinch back.

lines.zh: 我叼住一口，立刻退回洞里。
lines.en: I grab one mouthful and retreat into the burrow.

lines.zh: 你把东西晃一晃，我忍不住。
lines.en: You wave the food and I cannot help myself.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我整条都没动。
lines.en: Something rams me and my whole body does not move.

lines.zh: 水流撞我，我稳稳地立在洞里。
lines.en: The current hits me and I stand steady in my burrow.

lines.zh: 你脚碰到我，我只是弯了弯。
lines.en: Your foot brushes me and I merely bend.

lines.zh: 同伴挤过来，我们各让半寸。
lines.en: A neighbor crowds in and we each give half an inch.

lines.zh: 一股急流推我，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: A surge shoves me and I do not budge.

lines.zh: 鱼穿过我们中间，我晃都没晃。
lines.en: A fish cuts through us and I do not even sway.

lines.zh: 我撞到洞口边，尾巴却钉住了。
lines.en: I hit the burrow rim, but my tail stays anchored.

lines.zh: 被顶开一截，我又挺回原位。
lines.en: Shoved aside a bit, I stand right back up.

lines.zh: 沙被踩塌，我把身子撑住。
lines.en: The sand collapses under a foot and I brace myself.

lines.zh: 冲击过来，我只把头偏了偏。
lines.en: The impact comes and I only tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我朝隔壁的洞靠过去。
lines.en: I lean toward the burrow next door.

lines.zh: 我们两根一起摇，节奏相同。
lines.en: We two sway in the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 她缩进洞，我在外面等。
lines.en: She retreats into her burrow and I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我把身子弯向她那侧。
lines.en: I bend my body toward her side.

lines.zh: 两片沙洞靠得更近了。
lines.en: Our two patches of burrows draw closer.

lines.zh: 我们交换了一下位置。
lines.en: We trade places for a moment.

lines.zh: 她用尾巴碰了我的头。
lines.en: She touches my head with her tail.

lines.zh: 整片都在摇，只有我们并着。
lines.en: The whole patch sways, and only we stay paired.

lines.zh: 我守在她洞口，不走。
lines.en: I keep watch at her burrow and do not leave.

lines.zh: 暖水里，我们慢慢摆着。
lines.en: In the warm water we sway slowly.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒沙，又吐了。
lines.en: I pick up a grain of sand and spit it out.

lines.zh: 碎屑太小，我衔了三次。
lines.en: The crumb is so small I nip at it three times.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拖它，拖进洞里。
lines.en: I drag it with my mouth into the burrow.

lines.zh: 这东西比我的头还大。
lines.en: This thing is bigger than my head.

lines.zh: 我把它压在洞口下面藏着。
lines.en: I press it under the burrow mouth to hide it.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着它，我摆不稳了。
lines.en: With it in my mouth I cannot sway steadily.

lines.zh: 它滑走了，我伸长去追。
lines.en: It slips away and I stretch out after it.

lines.zh: 我咬住水草，扯断一截。
lines.en: I bite the seagrass and tear off a piece.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西，缩回沙里。
lines.en: Carrying it, I pull back into the sand.

lines.zh: 太重了，我松口让它落下。
lines.en: It is too heavy, so I let it fall.

lines.zh: 水一动，我立刻缩了半截。
lines.en: The water stirs and I retract halfway at once.

lines.zh: 那个影子的形状不对，我警觉。
lines.en: That shadow has the wrong shape and I grow wary.

lines.zh: 我认出了鲨鱼的轮廓。
lines.en: I recognize the outline of a shark.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼逃过来，我也缩了。
lines.en: A school of small fish flees past and I retract too.

lines.zh: 大东西靠近，我盯住它的方向。
lines.en: Something large nears and I track its direction.

lines.zh: 同伴全缩了，我知道有危险。
lines.en: My neighbors all retract, so I know there is danger.

lines.zh: 我把头对着那股水流。
lines.en: I turn my head into that moving water.

lines.zh: 有东西在挖沙，我听着。
lines.en: Something is digging in the sand and I listen.

lines.zh: 我看见了影子，就准备退。
lines.en: I see the shadow and prepare to withdraw.

lines.zh: 危险一来，我先认出它。
lines.en: When danger comes, I name it first.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞边，只露两只眼。
lines.en: I stay at the burrow rim with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 它游过去，我一直跟着转。
lines.en: It swims past and I keep turning to follow.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I lower myself until I am nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我一点点退，退到只剩头。
lines.en: I withdraw bit by bit until only my head shows.

lines.zh: 它转回来，我立刻定住。
lines.en: It turns back and I freeze instantly.

lines.zh: 我等着它游远再呼吸。
lines.en: I wait for it to swim off before breathing.

lines.zh: 沙面挡着我，我只探头看。
lines.en: The sand hides me and I only peek over it.

lines.zh: 它的影子挪一寸，我退一寸。
lines.en: Its shadow moves an inch and I retreat an inch.

lines.zh: 我没跑，我只是慢慢缩。
lines.en: I do not flee; I simply shrink slowly.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就整条钻下去。
lines.en: A little closer and I dive in entirely.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙小得可怜。
lines.en: I land a bite with my pitifully small teeth.

lines.zh: 它凑近洞口，我撞了它一下。
lines.en: It comes to my burrow and I butt it once.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴拍水，想赶走它。
lines.en: I whip my tail in the water to drive it off.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吓它，其实没牙。
lines.en: I gape at it to scare it, though I have no teeth.

lines.zh: 它咬住我半截，我拼命往回缩。
lines.en: It seizes half of me and I strain back into the burrow.

lines.zh: 我用头一顶，把它顶开半尺。
lines.en: One shove of my head pushes it back half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的身一弹，水花溅了它一脸。
lines.en: My body snaps and splashes it in the face.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍尖，死不松。
lines.en: I clamp its fin tip and will not let go.

lines.zh: 它一退，我立刻缩回洞里。
lines.en: The moment it backs off I dive into my burrow.

lines.zh: 我打不过，只能拖着身子挣。
lines.en: I cannot win, so I just drag myself and struggle.

lines.zh: 沙一动，我从洞里探出头。
lines.en: The sand shifts and I poke my head from a burrow.

lines.zh: 海草床里多了一排小洞。
lines.en: A row of little holes appears in the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 暖浅海的水很清，我钻出来。
lines.en: The warm shallows are clear and I come out.

lines.zh: 我们一家伙冒出七八条。
lines.en: Seven or eight of us pop up at once.

lines.zh: 我先钻洞，再慢慢直立。
lines.en: I dig in first, then slowly stand upright.

lines.zh: 这片沙很软，正合我意。
lines.en: This sand is soft, just as I like it.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，我露了出来。
lines.en: The wave pulls back and I am revealed.

lines.zh: 我选了同伴旁边的位置。
lines.en: I pick a spot beside my neighbors.

lines.zh: 沙里全是洞，我占了其中一个。
lines.en: The sand is full of holes and I claim one.

lines.zh: 我在新滩上摇晃着适应。
lines.en: On the new flat I sway while getting used to it.

lines.zh: 水烫了，我从洞里窜出来。
lines.en: The water heats up and I bolt out of the burrow.

lines.zh: 我被甩到滩上，沙全进了嘴。
lines.en: Flung onto the flat, I get sand in my mouth.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的身子软成一团。
lines.en: Out of water my body goes limp in a heap.

lines.zh: 爆响把我从沙里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast rips me out of the sand.

lines.zh: 尖东西钉进沙，擦过我的身。
lines.en: Something sharp stabs the sand and grazes my body.

lines.zh: 一股麻意顺着身子流下去。
lines.en: Numbness runs down the length of my body.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连头都支不稳。
lines.en: Hungry so long, I cannot even hold my head up.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 沙没了，我在空里挣扎。
lines.en: The sand is gone and I thrash in emptiness.
